purpose: Falsify, rather than promote, the proposed deterministic freshness-constrained multi-UAV service/network reconfiguration problem before any solver, environment, training, or benchmark is implemented.
candidate_scope: dynamic UAV communication failures with freshness/service deadlines, limited relay capacity, competing services, and reconfiguration decisions

allowed_toy.description: A two-slot, two-service deterministic truth table used only to prove or refute a strict myopic-versus-finite-horizon decision conflict.
